services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, or dead sockets? We diagnose and fix faults on the same day, often within the hour. All work fully guaranteed.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Servicing
services.desc: Gas-safe and OFTEC-trained engineers install and service boilers, reducing your heating bills and ensuring winter safety. New installations come with 10-year warranties.

services.title: Rewiring & Full Property Updates
services.desc: Old wiring poses a fire risk. We replace entire electrical systems to modern standards, improving safety and adding circuits for today's appliances.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Electrics
services.desc: Specialist work in damp environments. We install lighting, sockets, and extractor fans to Part P regs, with integrated RCD protection included.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old fuses with modern circuit breakers. Safer, more reliable, and often required for insurance or mortgage purposes.

services.title: EV Charging Point Installation
services.desc: Install a home or workplace charging point to Government-approved EICR standards. Cut petrol costs and future-proof your property.

about_pullquote: I started this to prove you don't need to overpay for honest electrical work.
about_para_1: Leeds Electrical was founded on a simple principle: fair prices, fast response, no nonsense. After years working for larger firms, we saw too many customers overcharged for straightforward jobs. We set up in Rothwell to serve local homes and small businesses with the same care and honesty. Every electrician on our team holds current Part P certification and full public liability insurance.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation the slow way—one satisfied customer at a time. Nine out of ten jobs requests come from referrals or repeat customers. What sets us apart is that we arrive on time, diagnose clearly, quote fairly, and finish when we say we will. No hidden charges, no cowboys, no excuses.
reviews_heading: What Rothwell Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done. Turned up on time, worked cleanly, and explained everything as he went. Price was honest and the work was solid. Really impressed.

reviews.text: Called them at 11pm on a Friday with a tripped consumer unit. They were here within 45 minutes and fixed it straight away. No fuss, no overtime surprise on the invoice. Will definitely call again.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Got a quote for a full kitchen rewire and it was half what another firm quoted. Work was completed on time and to a really high standard. Highly recommend.
